data.name: Attalanta
data.gender_notes: Attalanta is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Attalanta was a virgin huntress, revered for her purity and skill with a bow. Her name means 'she who will not be defeated' or 'unconquerable'. The name Attalanta carries the meaning “Nymph of hunting and chastity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Attalanta usually hope their child will grow to embody nymph of hunting and chastity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Attalanta belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nymph of hunting and chastity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Attalanta total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
